G0.label: Source and authority
G0.evidence: Baseline, build inputs, lockfile, compiler, executable hashes and commit-tree verification.

G2.label: Native execution path
G2.evidence: Native scan/filter metrics in the producer and cached native suffix on the hit.

G3.label: Rewrite semantics
G3.evidence: Independent schema, bag and ordered prefix, edge and refusal cases.

G4.label: Source and catalog identity
G4.evidence: Strict catalog pin, native source hashes and lineage changes.

G5.label: Cache integrity
G5.evidence: Reopen validates footer, key, exact schema/count and digest. Rehashed cross-entry substitution refuses.

G6.label: Durable publication
G6.evidence: Sync and no-replace publication exercised across process kills and restart.

G7.label: Reader lifetime
G7.evidence: Shared pins, contending writers, GC refusal, slot saturation and killed holder recovery.

G8.label: Security boundary
G8.evidence: Real Linux cross-UID refusals and macOS path, mode, traversal and hardlink cases.

G9.label: Resource accounting
G9.evidence: Encoded reservation, exact inventory lengths, output caps, cancellation and HFS+ ENOSPC.

G10.label: Source mutation and race
G10.evidence: Same-size mutation, catalog change, inode replacement and revoked source refusal.

G11.label: Defaults and compatibility
G11.evidence: Disabled/never controls, feature matrix, external Rust consumer and legacy workspace tests.

G12.label: Policy
G12.evidence: Independent exact rational oracle, checked coefficient refusal, zero/missing forecasts and a tie.

G13.label: Eviction
G13.evidence: Lower-value victim physically removed with an opposite LRU ordering.

G14.label: Audit
G14.evidence: Versioned decisions and operator/byte observations with independent identity checks.

G15.label: Independent process and oracle
G15.evidence: Distinct PID and downstream plan, process exit, root reopen and exact original-source results.

G16.label: Detached verification
G16.evidence: Sealed executable/source/fixtures and eight separately resealed semantic mutations.

G17.label: Economics
G17.evidence: Both fixed whole-sequence thresholds pass on one Apple M3 host, with a confirmation.

G18.label: Crash and fault
G18.evidence: Reached process kills, real ENOSPC, source drift, quota, cancellation and restart.

G19.label: Local release checks
G19.evidence: Workspace fmt, check, Clippy, all-feature tests, smoke, standalone consumer and Rust 1.94.0.

G20.label: Exact-commit hosted CI
G20.evidence: Requires hosted rust, msrv, phase22-interop and phase23-local receipts for this commit.

G21.label: Reporting
G21.evidence: ADR, guide, experiment, source-bound support matrix and detached evidence.

supported: native Scan → UInt64 Filter → optional Project
native GroupSumCount and optional downstream projections
one immutable pinned local Parquet catalog
one private cache root per trusted effective UID
source and payload independently verified on hit
bounded adaptive admission and physical eviction
